def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v}
    frames = []

    for color in colors:
        pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
        if r1-r0 >= 2 and c1-c0 >= 2:
            if (all(grid[r0][c] == color and grid[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0,c1+1))
                and all(grid[r][c0] == color and grid[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0,r1+1))):
                frames.append((color,r0,r1,c0,c1))

    frame_cells = {(r,c) for _,r0,r1,c0,c1 in frames
                   for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1)}
    extras = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
              if grid[r][c] and (r,c) not in frame_cells]
    if not extras or not frames:
        return out

    r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in extras), max(r for r,c in extras)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in extras), max(c for r,c in extras)
    pat = [[grid[r][c] != 0 for c in range(c0,c1+1)]
           for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    ph, pw = len(pat), len(pat[0])

    # Stamp the pattern into the closest-sized rectangular interior.
    color,a,b,x,y = min(frames, key=lambda f:
        abs((f[2]-f[1]-1)-ph) + abs((f[4]-f[3]-1)-pw))
    ih, iw = b-a-1, y-x-1
    for i in range(ih):
        for j in range(iw):
            pi = min(ph-1, i*ph//ih)
            pj = min(pw-1, j*pw//iw)
            out[a+1+i][x+1+j] = color if pat[pi][pj] else 0
    for r,c in extras:
        out[r][c] = 0
    return out
